field.heading: Heading
fieldSettings.title: Field settings
fieldSettings.hidden.intro: A hidden tracking field. It never shows on the form but its value is stored with every submission — ideal for UTM parameters, referrers or campaign IDs.
fieldSettings.hidden.nameHint: Key stored with each submission (e.g. utm_source).
fieldSettings.name: Name (technical)
fieldSettings.name.hint: Used as the key in submissions & the API payload.
fieldSettings.queryParam.hint: If the form URL has ?utm_source=… its value is captured automatically.
fieldSettings.defaultValue.hint: Used when the URL parameter above is absent.
fieldSettings.label: Label
fieldSettings.file.acceptHint: Comma-separated extensions (e.g. .pdf,.png,.docx). Unsafe formats are blocked automatically.
fieldSettings.rulesNote: Rules run on the public form and in the preview.
settings.title: Form settings
settings.inactive: ⚠ Inactive until a version is published.
settings.saveForLink: Save the form to generate the public link.
settings.customStyles.hint: Enable the Style editor to theme the public form.
settings.styleNote: Style changes follow draft / publish — they go live when you publish.
settings.rateLimit.hint: Cap submissions per IP each hour.
settings.captcha.hint: Human-verification challenge required before a submission is accepted.
settings.captcha.siteNote: Note: the site key can only be checked on the live form — an invalid site key shows no widget there.
settings.captcha.keysRequired: Enter both the site key and secret key, or set CAPTCHA to None.

tour.settings.body: Public page, spam protection, CAPTCHA and custom styles live in this drawer.

tour.publicpage.body: Turn this on to generate a shareable hosted page for the form (live once published).
tour.customstyles.title: Custom styles
tour.customstyles.body: Enable this to unlock the visual Style editor for theming the public form.

tour.style.body: Theme the public form visually — colours, fonts, corners and layout — with a live preview.

tour.preview.body: See the rendered form before you publish it.

tour.embed.body: Once the form is saved, grab the snippet here to drop it onto any website.
tour.publish.title: Publish
